body: Belmont Shore Parking and Business Improvement Area Advisory Commission
agenda_text:
BELMONT SHORE PARKING AND BUSINESS
  IMPROVEMENT AREA ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JUNE 18, 2026
  5365 2ND STREET
  FIRE STATION 8 COMMUNITY ROOM, 9:00 AM

Matthew Peterson, Chair  Jeffrey Cozart, Commissioner
Deborah Castro, Commissioner  Michael Jensen, Commissioner

  Members of the public have the option to email public comments to

  pw-bspbiaac@longbeach.gov

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

ANNOUNCEMENTS

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-55471  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Belmont Shore Parking and
  Business Improvement Area Advisory Commission meeting of Thursday, January
  15, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-55473  Recommendation to receive and file a Long Beach Public Works financial report
  discussing revenues during the period ending May 31, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-55474  Recommendation to receive and file the Long Beach Transit Employee Bus Pass
  Program Status for May 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-55475  Recommendation to receive status updates on Block by Block of Long Beach’s
  work in the Belmont Shore area, including responses to requests for assistance,
  for May 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-55476  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation regarding the annual special
  tax for Community Facilities District No. 2007-2 (Belmont Shore) for Fiscal Year
  2027.

  THURSDAY, JUNE 18, 2026

  FIRE STATION 8 COMMUNITY ROOM, 9:00 AM

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  26-55477  Recommendation to receive and file the 2025 Annual Report for Belmont Shore

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  26-55478  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion regarding after-hour activities,
  including noise and safety, at city-owned parking lots along the Belmont Shore.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

CHAIR ELECTION

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Belmont Shore Parking and Business Improvement Area Advisory
Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments
unless extended by the Chair.

ADJOURNMENT

I, Vanessa Hall, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior
to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the Americans
with Disabilities Act, please contact Vanessa Hall at cityclerk@longbeach.gov.

A motion was made by Chair Peterson, to elect Commissioner Castro for Chair of the
Belmont Shore Business Improvement Area Advisory Commission. The motion carried by
the following vote:

Yes:  4  Castro, Cozart, Jensen, Peterson
No:  0  None
Recused:  0  None
Abstain:  0  None
Absent:  0  None

Chair Peterson declared nominations open for Chair.

Chair Peterson nominated Commissioner Castro for Chair of the Belmont Shore Parking and
Business Improvement Area Advisory Commission.

Commissioner Castro spoke.
